write_up: This is a strong analyst resume! Your work at Carolina Home Goods connects SQL, dashboards, and merchandising recommendations to the teams using them. A recruiter can see both what you built and where it went.

The SQL model is a great model for the rest: it names what you wrote and the manual report it replaced. Your experience comes before education, and the move from insurance reporting to sales and merchandising analytics is easy to follow.

I'd read this for Data Analyst jobs, where the competition and a referral can still matter; your resume itself is unlikely to be the reason you're passed over. For this nursing posting, though, it doesn't show an RN license, clinical care, or EHR experience. Add those qualifications only if you have them.
